children: QumulusAI shares got a boost after the company said it has completed deployment of Nvidia Blackwell B300 GPU capacity at its Philadelphia colocation site.

The technology company said it has reached full customer handoff and activated an $18 million, two-year take-or-pay agreement with a GPU cloud marketplace currently serving AI teams in more than 100 regions worldwide.
The stock was 5% higher, at $6.85, in midday trading.
The company said the deployment represents the full scope of Nvidia Blackwell B300 capacity contracted under the agreement, now live and in production at its Philadelphia colocation site.
